purpose: Baseline identity inventory and bounded source-backed relationship review; preserve all profiles while separating programme membership from qualifying count.
review_scope: All 29 identity rows inventoried and mapped to direct named-derivative/predecessor evidence in 27 primary manufacturer publications (including original releases preserved by other hosts). Twenty-four HTML pages and three PDF releases support bounded identity relationships. Not a technical, model-year, photograph, licence, market-history or all-jurisdiction road-approval audit.

sources.title: Aventador LP 780-4 Ultimae
sources.read_scope: Overview and monocoque sections: manufacturer calls Ultimae a final version of the Aventador family. Not a new clean-sheet programme.

sources.title: Aventador S
sources.read_scope: Overview, steering and monocoque sections: S has rear-wheel steering and carbon-fibre monocoque; a material derivative within Aventador.

sources.title: Gallardo LP 560-4 Coupé
sources.read_scope: Design and drivability sections identify the named Gallardo coupe and four-wheel-drive concept. Current archive describes a revised nose; it does not verify every earlier model-year specification.

sources.title: Gallardo LP 570-4 Spyder Performante
sources.read_scope: Performance and design sections identify a lightweight V10 soft-top Gallardo derivative.

sources.title: Huracán EVO
sources.read_scope: Overview explicitly describes an evolution; LDVI and steering sections identify dynamics management and rear-wheel steering. These features are not transferred to every Huracán variant.

sources.title: Huracán STO
sources.read_scope: Opening and exterior/braking sections explicitly describe a road-legal motorsport-derived model with revised bodywork, Cofango and CCMR brakes. STO is not the original Super Trofeo race car.

sources.title: Huracán Sterrato
sources.read_scope: Opening, exterior and suspension sections identify raised suspension and Rally calibration. Additional front lamps carry a market-dependent public-road homologation qualification.

sources.title: Motorsport models: Heritage
sources.read_scope: 2009 Gallardo and 2015 Huracán LP 620-2 sections identify separate competition versions. Later Gallardo LP 570-4, Huracán EVO and GT3 entries are distinct named race specifications; their data and production totals are not imported.

sources.title: Aventador Coupé pre-owned guide
sources.read_scope: Spanish body identifies LP 700-4 launch in 2011 and first Aventador coupe. Header shows 1015 CV and speed unit kW: not accepted as LP 700-4 specifications.

sources.title: Aventador Roadster pre-owned guide
sources.read_scope: Body identifies 2012 LP 700-4 Roadster as convertible counterpart to coupe with removable two-piece carbon roof.

sources.title: Aventador S Roadster
sources.read_scope: Overview and exterior identify the S removable-roof derivative; steering section identifies rear steering. These features are not applied to original LP 700-4.

sources.title: Aventador Superveloce Coupé
sources.read_scope: Overview and body identify the lightweight SV coupe and magnetorheological pushrod suspension. No lap time, production total or numerical performance imported.

sources.title: Aventador Superveloce Roadster pre-owned guide
sources.read_scope: Body names LP 750-4 and two-piece carbon hardtop. Header 770 HP conflicts with detailed 750 CV (552 kW) table. Page supports identity only; numbers not imported.

sources.title: Aventador SVJ French archive
sources.read_scope: French exterior, ALA and steering sections identify SVJ coupe with ALA 2.0 and rear steering. English archive timed out; this public French archive was actually read. No SVJ 63 identity added.

sources.title: Aventador SVJ Roadster
sources.read_scope: Overview and exterior identify Aventador family membership and removable carbon roof; ALA section identifies 2.0 system. Table and narrative acceleration differ; numerical values not imported.

sources.title: Aventador LP 780-4 Ultimae Roadster
sources.read_scope: Overview explicitly places the final open-top Ultimae in Aventador family; exterior identifies removable hardtop. Allocation statement not treated as audited final production or survivor count.

sources.title: Huracán EVO RWD
sources.read_scope: Overview and drivetrain paragraph explicitly identify rear drive. Generic 4-WHEEL DRIVE heading conflicts with model-specific text; not used as AWD evidence. Optional dampers and LDS not generalized as standard.

sources.title: Huracán EVO Spyder
sources.read_scope: Opening and exterior identify open EVO derivative; steering/drivetrain sections describe rear steering and four-wheel drive for this model.

sources.title: Huracán EVO RWD Spyder Spanish archive
sources.read_scope: Spanish overview/exterior explicitly distinguish rear-drive open model from 4WD counterpart. Generic four-wheel-drive heading conflicts with the rear-drive body text; not used as AWD evidence.

sources.title: Huracán Coupé pre-owned guide
sources.read_scope: German body names original LP 610-4 coupe and carbon/aluminium chassis. Header 449 CV conflicts with detailed 610 PS (449 kW); header is not accepted as a power specification.

sources.title: Huracán Spyder
sources.read_scope: Overview and chassis identify V10 soft-top with carbon/aluminium chassis; drivetrain section describes electronically controlled all-wheel drive. Numeric power/reference year not independently established by this bounded page read.

sources.title: Huracán Performante
sources.read_scope: Overview and ALA sections identify lightweight materials and active aerodynamics within Huracán. Dampers and dynamic steering are described as optional; no new factory time or total imported.

sources.title: Huracán Performante Spyder
sources.read_scope: Overview/exterior identify open Performante with Forged Composites and ALA. Drivetrain section identifies AWD. These features do not make it a Super Trofeo competition car.

sources.title: Huracán Tecnica
sources.read_scope: Opening describes a member of Huracán range; engine section relates it to STO, with dedicated brake cooling and rear-wheel steering sections. No new programme inferred from unique name or body styling.

sources.title: Gallardo LP 570-4 Superleggera: original manufacturer release, 1 March 2010
sources.read_scope: Original manufacturer release preserved by GallardoSuperleggera.com. PDF page 1 text and rendered page actually read: names new LP 570-4 as Gallardo derivative and explicitly distinguishes its predecessor launched in 2007. This is identity/relationship evidence for both stored Superleggeras; exact 5.0 predecessor displacement, outputs, dates and totals not newly audited.

sources.title: Gallardo LP 560-4 Spyder: original manufacturer technical publication
sources.read_scope: Manufacturer publication preserved at dealer.com. PDF page 1 text and rendered page actually read: names LP 560-4 Spyder as open version of LP 560-4, with AWD and 5.2-litre V10. Generation language does not by itself settle independent qualifying credit. Remaining pages not visually audited.

sources.title: Gallardo LP 550-2 Valentino Balboni: manufacturer release, 30 June 2009
sources.read_scope: Manufacturer release on press-distribution host: web PDF text read, pages 1 and 2. Names a Gallardo version with rear drive and revised springs, dampers, stabilisers, tyres and aero. Local download failed certificate verification; no local render or PDF byte hash claimed. No 250 allocation, power, time or production statistic imported.

programme_groups.admission_case: Carbon-monocoque naturally aspirated V12 supercar programme, with meaningful chassis and final-series derivatives. Strong performance-icon candidate; individual variant counting remains open.
programme_groups.counting_status: pending; no numerical qualifying credit assigned by this review

programme_groups.admission_case: V10 supercar family with coupe, open, lightweight and rear-drive derivatives plus a separate one-make racing branch. Manufacturer release distinguishes original 2007 Superleggera predecessor from LP 570-4; Balboni involves dynamics and rear-drive changes, not merely a stripe. No independent variant credit assigned.
programme_groups.counting_status: pending; no numerical qualifying credit assigned by this review

programme_groups.admission_case: V10 supercar programme with evolved dynamics management, a road-going motorsport derivative and a raised-suspension derivative. Engineering differences warrant preserving profiles without automatically multiplying qualifying count.
programme_groups.counting_status: pending; no numerical qualifying credit assigned by this review

limitations: Programme grouping is a curation inference from existing identities and the cited manufacturer relationships; three road groups are not a certified three-car qualifying total.
Separate counting of same-programme bodies and performance derivatives remains pending the owner boundary. No profile is deleted, merged, or automatically declared a duplicate.
Two competition records retain road_legal=0; whether dedicated racing cars qualify remains pending.
All other baseline families and unreviewed fields remain open.
Failed retrospective URLs and homepage redirects were not used as supporting evidence.
